body:
@FlamingFireCoding, a quick "what's left" on this one. It looks close:

- It merges cleanly with current main, and the body is complete: what changed, the two pinning tests, the readings, and what was not exercised.
- The only step left is yours: **mark it ready for review** (`gh pr ready 3552`). It then gets its collaborator review. It is still a draft, so no reviewer has picked it up.
- The change is under `xtask/`, which is a process file (AGENTS.md). The `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is the merging session's job, so do **not** add one to this PR.

If you would rather we carry it from here, say so and we will.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fa9ba65d719e2f7d9625baac5416a87a1939ab05 -->
Needs changes before merge.

I read the full diff. This is the first review of this head. The trial merge with upstream/main is clean.

Requested before merge:

1. `xtask/src/unit_sweep_tests.rs:273-274`: The new package-link test fails on a case-insensitive macOS volume. The test first creates `camcraft-app`. On that volume, `CamCraft-App` names the existing directory. The symlink call cannot create that entry, so the assertion at line 274 fails. The Windows branch avoids this problem, but the macOS branch does not. Use a distinct link name, such as `other-app`, on macOS too. Correct the comment at lines 270-272. Run the test on a case-insensitive macOS volume. This breaks the rule that tests build and run on each supported platform. The Linux pass below does not test this failure.
2. `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67`: The required local clippy check fails with Rust 1.100.0. This code is unchanged from upstream/main. It is a failure of the merged tree, not a new defect in this diff. Resolve the failure with the maintainer before a green review. The check exits with code 101:

   ```text
   error: this `if` guard returns a bool literal and is followed by another
     --> xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67:5
   = note: `-D clippy::needless-bool` implied by `-D warnings`
   error: could not compile `xtask` (bin "xtask") due to 1 previous error
   ```

Local results:

- PR head: `fa9ba65d719e2f7d9625baac5416a87a1939ab05`.
- Main base: `29bb9e9a2048d59ec44d2ec8a52b2e5687822ff6`.
- Local trial merge: `84d05dba667ab89d5c59bf7f17771cabd994e3e8`. Its first parent is the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. One step; 381 tests passed across the xtask targets. All 14 unit-sweep tests passed, including both new tests. The real Linux `ps` process check ran in the gate summary. The sweep reported zero removed units.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: FAIL, as described above.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: PASS. All six steps passed in 11.3 minutes. The release build passed. The motion library passed seven tests. The island, neck, parallel, and app pocket-pass-start suites each passed one test. Total: 11 light tests, zero failures.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: zero reached steps. No heavy test ran.

Extra suites run:

- The light suites are listed above. No fixture, importer, post, operation, motion, or catalog file changes in this PR. The additional importer and example-catalog suites do not apply.

Scope and process checks:

- The change does not affect posted G-code, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation, or geometry. Safety mutations do not apply. No golden file moved.
- The change does not affect `crates/ui`. Screenshots do not apply.
- `Process change: yes` is present. The PR correctly leaves `PROCESS_VERSION` unchanged. The merging session owns that change.
- Issue #3173 also asks for a real macOS process-check run. The body has no such result. Add that evidence after the macOS test fix.
- I did not use a GitHub runner. I did not change code, labels, the title, or the draft state. The local worktree and branch remain for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed in part: the macOS branch now uses a distinct link name (`other-app`) so a case-insensitive volume cannot collide; the comment is corrected.
Not run on macOS - no macOS machine here; the macOS pass and the real macOS process-check evidence for #3173 stay owed.
Results on this head:
- `cargo test -p xtask a_link_at_the_package_level_is_skipped`: passed
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean on this machine (Rust `cargo 1.99.1`); the needless-bool failure reported at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` did not reproduce here. Please treat the clippy verdict on the toolchain that saw it.
- Full `cargo test -p xtask`: 274 passed, 3 failed. The three reds are pre-existing on the branch and outside this diff: `catalog_tests::catalog_seed_links_face_pocket_and_drill`, `catalog::links::tests::committed_slot_undercut_has_its_generated_catalog_block` (both ask for a `cargo xtask catalog` refresh of the committed metadata), and `light_tests::the_law_names_the_light_lane_and_the_local_full_rerun`. None touches `unit_sweep_tests.rs`.
The PR stays a draft.

macOS run for this PR (head `f3a556edb`), on a Mac at your request for the owed macOS pass. This is not a review.

- Machine: macOS, APFS boot volume, confirmed **case-insensitive** (creating `a` then opening `A` finds the same file). Toolchain: rustc 1.99.1.
- `cargo test -p xtask unit_sweep`: **14 passed, 0 failed**. This includes `a_link_at_the_package_level_is_skipped` (the case-insensitive collision is gone with `other-app`), `the_sweep_never_reads_or_deletes_through_a_link`, and `a_held_cargo_lock_or_a_live_process_removes_nothing` (the live-process check runs against the real macOS `ps`).
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **clean** on 1.99.1, the same as your machine. The `needless-bool` error in the review was seen on Rust 1.100.0, on code this PR does not change, so it belongs to main and the maintainer, not to this PR.

The macOS part of finding 1 is covered by this run. If you are done, mark the PR ready (`gh pr ready 3552`), and it gets its re-review.

Clean review. No blocking findings remain.

Earlier findings:

1. Fixed: `xtask/src/unit_sweep_tests.rs:274`. Commit `f3a556edb` uses `other-app` on every platform and corrects the comment. Both new tests pass locally. The [collaborator macOS run](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3552#issuecomment-7122908610) reports 14/14 unit-sweep tests passed on case-insensitive APFS. It also supplies the macOS process-check evidence accepted for this review.
2. No longer applies as a PR blocker: `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67`. Rust 1.100.0 reports `clippy::needless_bool` in unchanged code. I ran the same clippy command on bare upstream/main. It fails at the same location with the same diagnostic. The collaborator macOS run reports clean clippy on Rust 1.99.1. The maintainer has confirmed that this pre-existing failure does not block this PR. No matching open issue was found.

- The diff does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. Safety mutations do not apply. No goldens moved.
- The diff does not change `crates/ui`. Screenshots do not apply.
- The body contains `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none`, and `Fixes #3173`. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No GitHub runner was used. No code, labels, or draft state was changed. The review worktree and branch remain for the next round.

Requested before merge: none.

FlamingFireCoding: please mark the PR ready with `gh pr ready 3552 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` when your work is complete.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
